params.prompt:
SHOT: Extreme macro, 4:5, of the MIDDLE of the row of hearts, seen very close: FIVE hearts side by side in one straight row running across the whole frame from the left edge to the right edge: silver, gold pave, silver, gold pave, silver, the silver heart at each end cut by the edge of the frame, because the row of eleven continues out of frame on both sides. The hearts sit close together, almost touching, so between them the chain shows only as a short flat silver ribbon. Resting on the top face of a cream plaster cube. Camera very close; the row fills the frame from side to side; razor-sharp on the stones and the metal edges, the plaster falling softly out of focus.

THE PRODUCT: IMAGE 1 is our approved packshot of this exact piece and the ONLY authority on what it is: copy its construction, proportions, metal colour and stone colour EXACTLY; ignore its cube and its background. IMAGE 1 is a close view, so the piece's SIZE in this picture comes ONLY from the SCALE TEST below. IMAGE 2 is the authority for the plaster, the background and the light only.

CONSTRUCTION LOCK: A TWO-TONE HEART NECKLACE: a flat, smooth, bright SILVER TONE ribbon chain about 3mm wide that lies flat like a narrow strip of polished metal, threaded at the front with ELEVEN small puffed HEART beads in one row, alternating: a polished plain silver tone heart, then a gold tone heart covered in tiny clear pave stones, then silver again, and so on, starting and ending with silver (six silver hearts, five gold pave hearts). All hearts point down and touch each other. Exactly eleven hearts, alternating silver and gold pave, never all gold, never all silver; the chain is a flat silver ribbon, never gold; no pendant. Counted from one end the hearts run silver, gold, silver, gold, silver, gold, silver, gold, silver, gold, silver: never two silver hearts side by side, never two gold.

SCALE TEST: Each heart is about 7mm across; the five hearts in frame span about 4cm; the chain is about 3mm wide, about two fifths of a heart's width.

LIGHT: Soft large key from camera-left, one soft shadow, plus ONE small hard specular kicker from the right, so the metal shows a bright moving highlight and a dark rolled edge on every curve, and every stone shows internal sparkle and a hard white point, never flat colour.

ABSENCE LIST: No hand, no ear, no model, no fabric, no props. No second piece of jewellery. Metal: polished gold tone and bright silver tone exactly where IMAGE 1 shows them. No lettering, no watermark, no logo, no tag, no size sticker anywhere in frame. The picture runs edge to edge as a crisp, clean, modern digital studio photograph, shot today on a high-resolution digital camera.
